chapter: Cab Calloway's band: road, arrangers and shows
title: Theater tours by Pullman with Cab's baggage car and green Lincoln
summary: After the Cotton Club the band toured vaudeville theaters coast to coast by Pullman, with a baggage car holding trunks and Cab's green Lincoln.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: One Sweet [Unintelligible], all those great things. So that was the era. Traveling is what I want to get back to. We had six months in the Cotton Club, then we started… after the Cotton Club the next group would come in, Duke Ellington and Ethel Waters would be next, something like that. And we would start on theaters, theater tunes. We got a chorus girl, he‟s got dancers and…

Yeah, like Vaudeville. We started booking at the Brooklyn Theater and we‟d go to Newark, and we‟d go to Philadelphia, and we‟d go to Pittsburgh, and right across the country, Ohio, Akron, Ohio, Youngstown, Ohio, some place in Indiana, Chicago, Chicago Theater, Omaha, Nebraska, right on out to the coast, week by week. So it took you three months to do that. See that‟s three months of theaters. Now we traveled by train. You get Pullman cars and everything is great. Cab had a baggage car, the biggest one that you‟d ever want to see. He had a green Lincoln in there. He had them put a green Lincoln car in there and he had a chauffer. The baggage car was right next to our Pullman so if you were sleeping in your pajamas, you get up and go into the baggage car. We had those H&M theatrical trunks; open the truck up, put your fresh clothes on and put your other stuff in there and when we stepped off the train, we stepped off…
